title: Cape Arundel Golf Club
specs: Walter Travis designed links-style course with small greens and water views
Ranked #64 in GOLF Magazine's Top 100 Courses You Can Play and #1 in Maine

Golfers 12 years old and under must be accompanied by an adult

blurb: Cape Arundel Golf Club offers a Walter Travis designed links-style golf course known for its small greens, rolling terrain, and water views. Founded in 1896, it is ranked among the top courses in the U.S. and Maine. The historic clubhouse, named 41 House, overlooks the Kennebunk River and honors President George H.W. Bush, a former club champion.
extraNote: Public tee times may only be booked over the phone · No telephone calls or music allowed on the golf course · Pace of play: foursome walking expected to finish in 3:45 · Golf Shop located in 41 House clubhouse
